sentences.text:
------
CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE ANIL KUMAR CHOUDHARY ------
For the Petitioner : Mr. Amandeep Kr. Pandey, Advocate : Mr. Alok Kr. Dubey, Advocate For the State : Mr. Rajesh Kumar, Addl. P.P.
------
Order No.03 Dated- 08.09.2025 I.A. No.11140 of 2025 Heard the parties.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that this interlocutory application has been filed with a prayer to stay the execution of the orders dated 25.06.2025 and 04.08.2025, passed by the learned Additional Sessions Judge -I, Garhwa whereby and where under non-bailable warrant of arrest and the proclamation under Section 82 of the Cr.P.C. respectively have been issued against the petitioner in connection with Garhwa (SC/ST) P.S. Case No. 646 of 2022 involving the offences punishable under Sections 420, 504, 506 and 406 of the Indian Penal Code and under Section 3(1)(x), 3(1)
(xi), 3 (1)(j) and 3(1)(k) of the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities Act),
1989 by filing a supplementary affidavit dated 28.08.2025 in terms of the order dated 27.08.2025,
passed in this interlocutory application.
It is further submitted that the proclamation of the notice was issued on 05.08.2025 and the same was affixed on the house of the petitioner on 14.08.2025.

Considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case, since the proclamation under Section 82 of the Cr.P.C. has already been made, this Court do not find any justifiable reason to stay the same as the prayer for stay of the order dated 04.08.2025 has become infructuous.

sentences.text:
So far as the order dated 25.06.2025 is concerned, the petitioner is evading his arrest though he is accused of committing non-bailable offence in connection of which Garhwa (SC/ST) P.S. Case No.
646 of 2022 has been registered
. Hence, this Court do not find any justifiable reason to stay the execution of the order dated 25.06.2025.
Accordingly, this interlocutory application being without any merit is dismissed.
(Anil Kumar Choudhary, J.) Heard the parties.
List this criminal miscellaneous petition in due course under the heading "for Admission".
